t2.thesis: High short interest combined with strong 90-day earnings revision momentum and positive call skew favors an upside reaction following the recent 5-day consolidation.
reasons: Short interest stands at an unusually high 39.3% of float, setting up strong short-covering tailwinds on solid results.
EPS consensus has been consistently revised upward (+43.7% over 90 days from $0.66 to $0.95), reflecting strong fundamental execution.
Past three consecutive prints delivered positive overnight returns (average +4.1%), supported by positive call IV skew (+0.025) and a 6.7% 5-day pre-earnings pullback easing short-term froth.
t2.deciding_variable: Same-store sales comps and restaurant-level operating margin relative to consensus.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up from 0.55 to 0.60 (+0.05) due to the combination of extreme short interest (39%), strong EPS estimate upward momentum (+44%), and a healthy pre-earnings pullback.

theses.expected: Comps beat driven by traffic and average check, operating margins hold above 7.6%
theses.mechanism: High short float sparks short covering and buyers step in following the recent pullback
theses.wrong_if: Traffic softens or labor and commodity inflation compresses unit margins below expectations

theses.expected: In-line earnings with constructive FY26 unit growth and margin outlook
theses.mechanism: Positive call skew and modest valuation (P/S ~1.4x) keep the post-earnings drift positive into next morning's open
theses.wrong_if: Management guides down Q4 consumer dining traffic amid macro headwinds

theses.expected: Guidance cut or margin squeeze triggers aggressive selling
theses.mechanism: Year-to-date doubling in stock price creates vulnerability to profit-taking despite short interest
theses.wrong_if: Short sellers rush to cover any shallow dip, preserving open gains

key_observations: Cheesecake Factory comparable restaurant sales growth vs. prior quarter's +5.8%
Updates on FY26 development cadence across North Italia and Flower Child
Q4 guidance for restaurant-level margins and commodity inflation
